Common Contact Questions

Before You Call — FAQ

The six things most homeowners want to know before reaching out.

How fast do you respond to a free-estimate request?
Within 1 business day for standard estimates. Aaron or Doug — not an auto-reply — responds directly. For after-hours emergencies (storm damage, tree on structure), the 24/7 line answers immediately with 1–2 hour on-site response in Tier 1 cities.
Do you charge for estimates?
No. Every Roubic estimate is free and includes an in-person property walk-through — no trip charge, no obligation to book, no upsell. Aaron or a lead foreman documents access, hazards, and pricing before you commit to anything.
What areas do you serve?
A 40-mile radius from our Auburn Township yard covering 13 NE Ohio cities across Cuyahoga and Geauga counties. Tier 1 (priority): Auburn Township, Pepper Pike, Chagrin Falls, Moreland Hills, Solon. Tier 2 (2-day): Gates Mills, Beachwood, Orange, Bainbridge Township, Shaker Heights. Tier 3 (2–3 day): Chesterland, Mayfield, South Russell.
Do you work with insurance for storm-damage claims?
Yes. Every storm / tree-on-structure job includes a full insurance-documentation packet — photos, written scope, signed estimate — designed to submit directly to your homeowner's carrier. Call the 24/7 line first, then we handle the paperwork.
Can I schedule an estimate online?
Yes — fill out the form above with your name, phone, service needed, and address. Aaron or Doug will call to confirm and schedule the on-site visit within 1 business day. Prefer to talk first? Call {{global.phone}}.
Is Aaron the person I'll actually talk to?
Yes. {{global.owner_name}} — the owner — handles all sales and visits every job site personally. On rare occasions when Aaron is on a job, lead foreman Doug Battiest (10-year tenure) will respond. There's no phone tree, no franchise operator, no rotating regional manager between you and the person removing your tree.

Prefer to Talk Directly? Call Aaron.

The form above is the fastest way to book. But if you'd rather talk — Aaron or Doug is at the other end of the line.
